title: Fast loading of collections after restart
body:
Hello
I try to upload huge amount of vectors into qdrant.
~ 100 millions vectors.

After restart Qdrant reads a long time data from disk and It uses only 3 threads.
How can I speed up the loading of collection data into memory?

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Are you sure that the bottleneck is not disk?

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: Could you share the configuration of such collection? Is this an on-disk collection?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
> Could you share the configuration of such collection? Is this an on-disk collection?

similar to https://github.com/qdrant/qdrant/issues/2350#issue-1825877905

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
It looks like your vector data is on disk. For that, memory maps are used to map data that is on disk into memory.

On restart, Qdrant will _preload_ all vector data. It basically reads all vector data from disk into memory to warmup cache and provide better response times. This is a background task and shouldn't affect operation. This process may take a while. Could this be the reason you're seeing the long read time?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
> Are you sure that the bottleneck is not disk?

I have only a SSD storage for qdrant.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Could very well be a slow disk indeed.

If no `on_disk` flags are set, all data is loaded in memory before Qdrant is ready, this can take a very long time. If `on_disk: true` is set, it will try to load contents from disk in the background and Qdrant should be ready right away.
